description: This file defines an abstract class 'ConsumerStrategy' and multiple concrete implementations for Kafka consumer strategies used in Spark Streaming Kafka integration. It includes methods for subscribing to topics, patterns, or specific partitions, and handles consumer configuration and initialization.

classes.name: ConsumerStrategy
classes.description: Abstract class defining methods for creating and configuring Kafka consumers, including executor parameters and consumer instantiation.

classes.name: Subscribe
classes.description: Implementation of ConsumerStrategy that subscribes to a list of topics, with logic for handling offsets and consumer setup.

classes.name: SubscribePattern
classes.description: Implementation of ConsumerStrategy that subscribes to topics matching a regex pattern, with offset management.

classes.name: Assign
classes.description: Implementation of ConsumerStrategy that assigns specific TopicPartitions, with offset handling.

methods.name: setAuthenticationConfigIfNeeded
methods.description: Updates Kafka parameters with security configurations if required.
